dimensions.name: content_quality
dimensions.meaning: Section prose is coherent, investor-useful, and specific to the ticker/section.
dimensions.fail_cues: Generic filler, empty draft, off-topic content, or pure boilerplate.

dimensions.name: coverage_vs_plan
dimensions.meaning: Answers the planned questions / todos; coverage report aligns with delivered artifacts.
dimensions.fail_cues: Plan questions ignored, no answer cards for key questions, coverage claims without substance.

dimensions.name: faithfulness
dimensions.meaning: Factual claims and numbers are supported by evidence_ledger, citations, or tool outputs.
dimensions.fail_cues: Fabricated numbers, unsupported assertions, citations that do not match claims.

dimensions.name: gaps_honesty
dimensions.meaning: Unresolved gaps and data-quality notes are candid; does not overclaim confidence.
dimensions.fail_cues: Hides known gaps, invents certainty, or silently omits contradictions.
